event.description: Reduce d14 FF width from 24 to 23
event.proposal: family: feed-forward width; current retained incumbent is 3038 parameters at 99.9100%, a +0.91 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0043 established d14 with ff24 at 3038/99.91%; same-family failed result: attempt-0037, head-block-diagonal FF at 2624/89.01% (the adjacent d16 ff15 trial was 3072/56.60%); prior attempts in this family: 11. Hypothesis: the d14/ff24 model leaves a direct one-unit FF interpolation unexplored; reduce only ff24 to ff23, preserving full cross-head FF mixing and all successful attention/normalization choices, for 3010 parameters. This is more informative than the prior block-diagonal FF failure because it tests scalar capacity at the new d14 operating point without changing connectivity; the nearest untested alternative is ff22, which would skip the boundary and confound the size of the capacity loss. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, affine-free block pre-norms, final learned scale without bias, learned positions, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3038 parameters.
